summary: Wilmington Airport (ILG/KILG) is a medium-sized public airport located in unincorporated New Castle County, about 5 miles south of downtown Wilmington, Delaware. Formerly known as New Castle Airport, it has historical roots dating back to World War II when it served as a military airbase and was once home to the Delaware Air National Guard. Today it functions as a general aviation and regional commercial hub, offering an alternative to the busier Philadelphia International Airport just 25 miles northeast.
faqs:
Q: How far is Wilmington Airport from downtown Wilmington?
A: The airport is approximately 5 miles south of downtown Wilmington, typically a 10-15 minute drive via I-95.

Q: Does Wilmington Airport offer commercial passenger service?
A: Yes, it has limited commercial service operated by regional carriers, along with general aviation and charter flights. Check current schedules as service varies.

Q: Is there an alternative major airport nearby?
A: Philadelphia International Airport (PHL) is about 25 miles northeast and offers significantly more flight options.

Q: Are car rentals available at the airport?
A: Yes, several car rental agencies serve the airport, though availability can be limited compared to larger hubs, so booking in advance is recommended.
transport_tips: The airport is conveniently located just off Interstate 95, making it easily accessible by car from Wilmington, Philadelphia, and Baltimore. Ride-share services like Uber and Lyft operate in the area, and taxi service is available though advance booking is advisable. Ample free parking is available in the on-site lots, which is a notable advantage over larger regional airports.
local_tip: Frequent visitors recommend timing arrivals around rush hour—traffic on I-95 through Wilmington can add significant delays, but using the back roads through New Castle or the scenic Route 9 waterfront route can be a faster and more pleasant alternative.
